predicate.label: supports or endorses
predicate.definition: Entity X explicitly gives political, material, or institutional support or endorsement to Y.
includes: explicit supports, backs, endorses, or provides identified aid to Y
voting for Y as an endorsement
excludes: ordinary alliance or meeting without support assertion
physical support of an object unrelated to the institutional relation
ambiguous: unclear support versus pressure or opposition
a future proposed endorsement without realization
predicate.notes: This does not imply permanent agreement or exclusive support. A bare give edge is insufficient without an identified supportive act or other local evidence.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit supports, backs, endorses, or provides identified aid to Y; voting for Y as an endorsement; historical support. Excludes: merely pressuring or criticizing Y; ordinary alliance or meeting without support assertion; generic possession or acquisition; physical support of an object unrelated to the institutional relation. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: give with omitted object; unclear support versus pressure or opposition; a future proposed endorsement without realization. This does not imply permanent agreement or exclusive support. A bare give edge is insufficient without an identified supportive act or other local evidence.

rationale: Forward support and stand-with-exception form a weak identifiable support family; aid-by has reverse direction and is not pooled as forward support. Obituary residence attachment and reverse disavowal letter do not identify stronger competing primary meanings. Independently reviewed by Boyle.
